narrative: The forty leaves, shut, the rule still under the last line. No numbers written in the corners. No second book. Gib is on the Holinshed. No face. No printed sheet on the board. The coffer shut. Brooke on the shelf, shut. No face.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Looked, and left the one stack.

entities.name: Richard II
entities.context: Shown on draft in The same forty
